title: POSTCARDS FROM THE OTHER TOWN · VII
venue: Arthur's site · a romance the strip never ran · eight cards · Box 19
logline: Hers: the front is the lighthouse with its lamp lit, drawn at the right scale for the first time, a bus stopped at the headland's foot the right scale too; the back, one word, and the address side blank.

panels.composition: The postcard's front: a lighthouse at its true scale on a headland with its lamp lit and a bus stopped at the headland's foot at its true scale, the first card where the sizes agree.

image.prompt: two-color coastal weekly illustration, a lighthouse and a bus stopped at the foot of its headland both drawn at true scale with the lamp lit, no words legible

panels.name: Front

panels.composition: The postcard's back: the address side blank, the message side one word legible and nothing else.

image.prompt: the back of a postcard drawn in ink, a divided back with an address side and a message side, the handwriting rendered as strokes with one word left legible, a small stamp with a tiny numeral in its corner, an address side left entirely blank, no words legible but one
image.notes: The seventh word is the canon's 2013 note's word. The address blank: not sent, or hand-delivered; reserved. The one legible word: come. Stamp numeral: VI.

panels.name: Back

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink for the fronts; the backs in a stranger's hand, drawn as shapes but for one word each
art.palette: the fronts in the coastal weekly's two-color; the stamps in one color each
art.paper: cardstock cut to postcard size, drawn both sides, photographed as spreads
